python
import gdb, struct, json, time
samples = 0
exit_code = None
def inventory():
    global samples
    samples += 1
    if samples > 128:
        raise gdb.GdbError("snapshot quota exceeded")
    base = int(gdb.parse_and_eval("(unsigned long long)&'stats_alloc::INSTRUMENTED_SYSTEM'"))
    values = struct.unpack("<65546q", bytes(gdb.selected_inferior().read_memory(base, 0x80050)))
    rows = [(i, count) for i, count in enumerate(values[:65537]) if count]
    oversized_blocks, oversized_bytes, failures = values[65537:65540]
    allocs, frees, resizes, allocated_bytes, freed_bytes, resized_bytes = values[65540:]
    blocks = sum(count for _, count in rows) + oversized_blocks
    size = sum(i * count for i, count in rows) + oversized_bytes
    coherent = blocks == allocs - frees and size == allocated_bytes - freed_bytes and failures == 0
    if len(rows) > 512:
        raise gdb.GdbError("row quota exceeded")
    print("FROZEN_INVENTORY", json.dumps({"index": samples, "unix_millis": int(time.time() * 1000), "rows": rows, "bytes": size, "blocks": blocks, "oversized_blocks": oversized_blocks, "oversized_bytes": oversized_bytes, "failures": failures, "coherent": coherent}))
def ended(event):
    global exit_code
    exit_code = getattr(event, "exit_code", None)
    print("FROZEN_END", json.dumps({"exit_code": exit_code, "samples": samples}))
gdb.events.exited.connect(ended)
bp = gdb.Breakpoint("<stats_alloc::StatsAlloc<std::alloc::System>>::stats", internal=True)
bp.commands = "silent\npython inventory()\ncontinue\n"

end
continue
python assert exit_code == 0 and samples == 5, "incomplete inventory calibration"
quit
